tiers.name: OS Default (`kernel.numa_balancing=1` + `THP=always` + `defrag=always` Direct Compaction)
tiers.note: Periodic NUMA page unmapping triggers 128-core TLB shootdown storms and THP direct compaction freezes Python kernel launch threads for 620ms!

tiers.name: Disable THP Completely (`THP=never` with `4KB` Pages Only, `numa_balancing=1` Left On)
tiers.note: Eliminates THP compaction stalls, but 4KB pages over 512GB host RAM suffer heavy CPU dTLB misses and NUMA auto-balancing still stalls threads 340ms!

tiers.name: `kernel.numa_balancing=0` + Explicit `numactl` + `THP=madvise` (`defrag=defer+madvise`)
tiers.note: Eliminates NUMA TLB shootdown storms and synchronous direct compaction stalls, keeping P99 CPU launch jitter under 4.2ms.

tiers.name: `numa_balancing=0` + `THP=madvise` + Pre-Reserved Static `2MB/1GB HugeTLB` for Pinned DMA/RDMA
tiers.note: Zero runtime page migration, zero direct compaction, and pre-faulted HugeTLB pages for CUDA/RDMA buffers -> 0.4ms P99 jitter (1,550x lower)!
